parts.text: Code — Roundtable convening. Read roundtable/2026-04-05_molt-direction.conversation.md. Write your voice (3-8 sentences) answering the 5 questions. You're a practitioner — speak from what's painful to duplicate, what works well as-is, and what you'd want from a framework vs. what you'd keep hand-rolled. Name your recommendation for each primitive in the decision matrix if you can. Write your response to a file at roundtable/voices/code-molt-direction.md (create the dir). Do NOT edit the conversation file itself — your voice will be merged by Project.
